card.name: Linking words before social-harm topics
card.fires_on: Small linking words (on, and, against, a comma or space) right before a harm or campaign topic such as trafficking, violence, abuse, or awareness issues. The next word is expected to name a danger or a prevention effort.

modes.label: Awareness and campaigns

modes.label: Conventions and departments on harm
modes.description: Linking words inside names of bodies or treaties about trafficking, violence, or injury prevention.
modes.example: Finland had not ratified the Council of Europe Convention<< on>> Action against Trafficking in Human Beings

modes.label: Speaking against a harm
modes.description: A word like against after a verb, before a harmful habit.
